images.caption: Fig. 1||Overview.a, One step of the long multiplication 74,829×\times6,153 (step 33 of 56). The view (three cells, 32×\times96 pixels) enters Qwen3.5-0.8B as three image tokens after the operation tokenMUL; the outputs, read at=and two placeholder positions, are the digit, the carry and the next operation. Below: the operation sequence of the full product.b, Margins of all 2,446 views on the deployment device (Apple M4, WebGPU, 16-bit), grouped by table. The smallest margin, 3.02 logits, belongs to the addition view 5 + 6 with no incoming carry.c, Exact answers on the pre-registered comparison of 220 problems (sums of 10–1,000 digits and products of 2–20-digit numbers, 20 per length; Methods), overall and on the longest sums and products. Sketchpad in rose, the strongest alternative in cobalt; Qwen3.5-0.8B is shown without chain of thought, its better setting. Per-length results: Extended Data Fig.1.

Fig. 2||The sheet machine.a, One view and its outputs for each calculator table.b, Left: the division 4,100÷\div59; the borrow out of the leading column indicates that the estimate 8 is too high. Right: the operation sequence of the same division (Knuth’s Algorithm D) and of the square root of 2,000,000 (56 forward passes).c, Batching four independent procedures: 32 forward passes instead of 73. Measured time against the cost model for the 200 problems of the browser test (median ratio 1.01).d, Time per problem in the browser test, all 200 exact.

Fig. 4||Algebra.a, Factorisation ofx3−6​x2+11​x−6x^{3}-6x^{2}+11x-6. Numbers in rose were computed by the model; each is linked to the column operation that produced it.b, Rejection rates under fault injection: incorrect roots (200 of 200 for both routes) and one corrupted arithmetic result (185 of 200 for the textbook route, 173 of 200 for evaluation).c, Time per benchmark problem: textbook route measured on the M4 (rose) and under the cost model (open rose); evaluation route under the cost model (cobalt).

Fig. 6||Mechanism.Arithmetic adapter.a, Logit lens: fraction of views whose top token at each depth equals the final output, by operation; ticks mark the median decision depth, triangles the ends of full-attention layers.b, Final-layer states projected onto three discriminant directions, coloured by output, for addition (0–19) and multiplication digits; nearest-centre shares are measured in this projection (Methods).c, Fraction of 80 steps whose output a class-mean intervention changes to its target, against the depth at which it is applied, for addition and multiplication; the shaded band is the fifth full-attention layer.
